text:
maya: Quick q — 20min bike commute, need music that keeps me mellow but awake and a short easy read for mornings. Any recs? :bike: :coffee:

sam: Tycho and Bonobo mixes. Try 'Dive' by Tycho or the 'Late Night Tales' Bonobo comp. Also this chill instrumental playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4WYpdgoIcn6

jess: For books, short story collections are perfect. 'Etgar Keret' or 'Tenth of December' by George Saunders. Light, funny/bittersweet. :books:

noah: If you want instrumental with a beat, Emancipator and Khruangbin. Also Nujabes for that morning glide.

marta: Movie/shorts option — 'La Jetée' is 28 mins and beautiful if you want something cinematic on a slow day. Or check the Vimeo shorts section for 10–20 min indie films: https://vimeo.com/channels/shortoftheweek

sam: also try folding ambient with a couple upbeat songs at the end so you wake up just before work. My quick playlist: `spotify:playlist:5aBcD...` (made for 18min commutes)

maya: love these, saving. anyone have anything more folky/acoustic? want something with vocals but not shouty.

jess: Iron & Wine early stuff or José González. soft vocals, great for pedals.

noah: +1 José González. also check Zoe Keating for cello loops, instrumental but warm.

marta: book rec for folky vibe — 'The Bear' by Andrew Krivak? short-ish and lyrical.

dev-bot: Reminder: weekly bike rack space update in #general — bring a lock! :lock: (not a recommendation but logistics :grimacing:)

sam: haha noted :lock:

maya: thanks all, gonna try Nujabes + Tenth of December tomorrow. will report back. :thumbsup:
